addictionPotential: 中度成瘾且滥用潜力高。
summary: βk-MDMA 是卡西酮类兴奋剂与共情剂，结构与 MDMA 相似，但更具刺激性且共情性较弱。在 2013 年被禁之前常在街头被误售为 MDMA。Marquis 试剂可区分 βk-MDMA 与 MDMA。效力低于 MDMA，持续时间略短。
effectsSummary: [TBT] Compared to MDMA, methylone has a stronger stimulating and less empathogenic effect. The effect is more constant, the "hangover" less than with MDMA.
generalRisks: [TBT] Short-term side effects are increased body temperature and heartbeat, dilated pupils and tightening of the jaw. The side effects and the (long-term) risks of methylone have hardly been researched yet.
saferUse: [TBT] Refrain from re-throwing: This does not intensify or prolong the flash with methylone.
[TBT] Be sure to drink enough water during the effect.
[TBT] Do not combine methylone with alcohol and other drugs, especially MAO inhibitors.
[TBT] Do not use methylone if you have heart or circulatory problems, high blood pressure, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy or mental health problems.
